shouldFix.title: The load-bearing D-293 fixture-choice delegation is absent from the candidate's declared authority lineage
shouldFix.measurement: D-056 Decision 5 makes fixture authoring lawful design work but does not delegate the underdetermined witness choices. D-293 Decision 8 is the adopted act that delegates the two DR-122 SARIF fixture obligations under the agreed semantic, coverage, dependency, and D-000 constraints. The candidate exercises that grant by selecting REQUEST.UNKNOWN_OPTION, interrupted plus SIGTERM, and json, but /basedOn has no D-293 edge and /recordedInputs has no pin for DECISIONS-RECOMMENDED.md at 42f27394746d4aac569a09a01da719c0cf318cf114086635e73097a6add97370. The live COORD file is pinned generically, while /basedOn/d295 expressly says it is last-heading custody only; neither field identifies D-293 as the authority for these selections.
shouldFix.whyShouldFix: The selected fixture values are all inside recorded schemas, so this is not a fixture-byte or semantic MUST-FIX. It is nevertheless a load-bearing provenance omission: without the dispatch prompt, the frozen candidate does not state why it may make choices its predecessor bind expressly declined to make. A later recording should not have to infer the delegation by searching an undifferentiated COORD pin.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Add an explicit /basedOn edge for D-293 Decision 8, including adoption commit c10319d207cb90e2bf9df4c5e5997cfd35a30193 and the adopted DECISIONS-RECOMMENDED.md digest, add that source to /recordedInputs, and state that the concrete existing-schema witness selections exercise that delegation. Do not change the fixture semantics, mint an identifier, record the candidate, remasure leftover-join.v4, or claim SATISFIED or QUALIFIED as part of this repair.
